# Lab 10.9: Create a Secure Custom VPC & Firewall Rules

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a custom-mode VPC with no default rules exposed to the internet, and allow SSH only from Google's IAP range.

## Steps

1. **Create a custom-mode VPC and subnet.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks create secure-vpc --subnet-mode=custom

gcloud compute networks subnets create app-subnet \
  --network=secure-vpc \
  --region=us-central1 \
  --range=10.10.0.0/24 \
  --enable-private-ip-google-access</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Add a default deny for ingress with logging.** The implied deny exists, but an explicit rule can be logged.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-rules create deny-all-ingress \
  --network=secure-vpc --direction=INGRESS --action=DENY \
  --rules=all --source-ranges=0.0.0.0/0 --priority=65000 \
  --enable-logging</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Allow SSH only from IAP to tagged VMs.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-ssh-from-iap \
  --network=secure-vpc --direction=INGRESS --action=ALLOW \
  --rules=tcp:22 --source-ranges=35.235.240.0/20 \
  --target-tags=ssh --priority=1000 --enable-logging</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create a VM with no external IP.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create app-vm \
  --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro \
  --subnet=app-subnet --no-address --tags=ssh</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Connect through IAP.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh app-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Compare with the default network.** Open **VPC network → Firewall** and look at the `default-allow-ssh` and `default-allow-rdp` rules on the default network, open to `0.0.0.0/0`. This is why production should not use the default network.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete app-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute firewall-rules delete allow-ssh-from-iap deny-all-ingress --quiet
gcloud compute networks subnets delete app-subnet --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute networks delete secure-vpc --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| External IP | None on the VM |
| SSH | Only through IAP, range `35.235.240.0/20` |
| Ingress from internet | Denied and logged |
| Default network | Too open for production |
